items.text: Among adults meeting the ambulance service's tranexamic acid criteria after injury between 2023 and 2026, what proportion received tranexamic acid within three hours of injury, and how does this differ by crew configuration, age and transport time?
items.population: Adults meeting the pre-hospital tranexamic acid criteria
items.comparator: Pathway standard: all eligible patients treated within three hours
items.outcome: Proportion treated within three hours; median time from injury to dose
items.setting: Regional ambulance service in a rural network

finer: Feasible with the audit team's access; interesting to paramedics and trauma teams; novel locally; ethical as an approved clinical audit; relevant because the pathway has never been checked. The outcome question is not included until linkage is allowed.
summary: One audit question answerable from ambulance records.
